# watchpoint_threshold_profile (Resource)

A threshold profile defining per-metric warning/critical thresholds and consecutive-breach logic applied to monitor check results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_threshold_profile" "example" {
  name = "Strict"
  rules = [
    {
      metric               = "ResponseTimeMs"
      operator             = "GreaterThan"
      warning_value        = 2000
      critical_value       = 5000
      consecutive_breaches = 2
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable profile name.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default threshold profile. Defaults to `false`.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Threshold rules evaluated against check results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Threshold profile ID.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this is a global, system-managed profile (read-only).

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `critical_value` (Number) Value at which a critical alert is raised.
- `metric` (String) Metric to evaluate. One of `ResponseTimeMs`, `DnsLookupMs`, `TlsHandshakeMs`, `TimeToFirstByteMs`, `TotalTimeMs`, `StatusCode`, `BodySizeBytes`, `SslDaysToExpiry`, `SyntheticTotalTimeMs`, `SyntheticStepCount`, `ErrorRate`, `PacketLoss`, `DnsResolutionMs`, `TcpConnectTimeMs`, `PingLatencyMs`, `PingPacketLossPercent`.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator. One of `GreaterThan`, `LessThan`, `Equals`, `NotEquals`.
- `warning_value` (Number) Value at which a warning is raised.

Optional:

- `consecutive_breaches` (Number) Consecutive breaching checks required before alerting. Defaults to `1`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_threshold_profile.example tp_001
```
